data.name: Private Custom Yacht Charters
data.headline: Private Charter • Secure your Date with a Deposit • From 2 - 48 People • Starting at $2070
data.description:
##Looking for a private yacht charter in San Diego?
The Adventuress is a gorgeous 60′ luxury catamaran available exclusively for private charter in San Diego.

Our luxury Catamaran is the ideal venue for entertaining, allowing guests to mix and mingle in a relaxed and spacious atmosphere. We pride ourselves on providing first class customer service, ensuring that every detail is taken care of, so you and your guests can relax and enjoy an amazing and memorable experience on the water.

Whether you are celebrating a special occasion, hosting a corporate event or simply enjoying a beautiful day on the water, we offer fully customized excursions tailored to meet the unique needs of you and your guests.
data.duration: 2 to 4.5 Hour Charters Bookable Online (Call for longer charters)

meeting_point.address: Safe Harbor/Cabrillo Isle Marina 1450 Harbor Island Dr San Diego, CA US 92101

data.what_is_included: This is a fully custom charter. Secure your date with a deposit (we require a payment of the 1st hour) and our Concierge team will reach out promptly to customize your charter and determine the total cost to include any catering, beverage service and/or other special requests. Please select your approximate start time, but if you would like to adjust the time by a few minutes, we can discuss this on our introductory call. Please note that catering, beverage service, other special requests are additional. Please call us at (619)781-7100 if you would like more information before securing a date!
data.cancellation_notes:
If you cancel outside 14 days from the charter date, the deposit will be refunded in full. In the event of a cancellation less than 14 days from the charter date, the client will owe the deposit amount. If the charter is canceled within 48 hours of the charter date, the client will owe the entire charter amount.

In the event that the Captain decides to cancel the charter due to inclement weather and/or sea conditions that he deems are unsafe for navigation, we will attempt to reschedule the charter if possible.  If the charter cannot be rescheduled, then a full refund will be issued.  If the charter cannot be met due to mechanical failure that cannot be resolved or the said vessel cannot be delivered as agreed, charter fees and or deposit shall be returned in full.
